name: Almost Heaven Logan 1-Person Indoor Sauna
description: Almost Heaven Logan Respite Series Sauna—Perfect Indoor 1-Person Traditional Sauna for Small Spaces The Almost Heaven Logan, a1-person indoor sauna, was designed with the space-conscious in mind. Now, you can experience a traditional sauna even in an apartment, your bathroom, or closet. Measuring 53"W x 36"D x 78"H, the compact rectangular shape guarantees it won’t be taking up much space, making it the perfect sauna for small spaces! One person can enjoy their Logan sauna with temperatures up to 180ºF. Turn the Harvia 4.5kW electric heater on right away and bask in the warmth in an hour, or use the delay function up to eight hours. Relax in your home sauna any day of the week with the Logan 1-person indoor sauna! NOTE: The Almost Heaven Logan 1-person indoor sauna can be upgraded to a Hybrid Sauna Setup (Traditional + Infrared). Features Below are some features and specifications of the Almost Heaven Logan 1-person indoor sauna. Tongue-and-groove lumber sections: 1-3/8" finished thickness Pre Assembled wall and roof sections Utilizes the existing floor. Suitable options include concrete, ceramic, vinyl, laminate, or tile flooring (carpet not recommended) Tempered glass door Stainless steel hinges, heater, and fasteners Interior LED light Wide bench Indoor usage Hand-crafted construction Easy assembly for two people Best-in-class heater and sauna stones Limited lifetime warranty on the Logan 1-person indoor sauna room; 5-year limited lifetime warranty on the heater and its components, with a 1-year warranty on the heating elements (coils) Made in the USA Specifications Holds one person Heater size: 4.5kW, 240V, 30-amp requirement, hard-wire connect Lighting electrical: 110V, 15-amp service, plug-in connect Exterior dimensions: 53"W x 36"D x 78"H Interior dimensions: 49"W x 31"D x 77"H Bench dimensions: 31"L x 16"W x 22"H Door size: 64"H x 24"W Window size: 64"H x 17"W Shipping size: 72"L x 40"W x 30"H Assembly weight: 500 lbs. Shipping weight: 525 lbs. Note: All dimensions are approximate. Options & Customizations Lumber type: For your Logan 1-person indoor sauna, you can choose between two different types of solid lumber. A rustic fir sauna is light in color, and you’ll be able to see small knots creating a unique pattern on each lumber piece.Getting a rustic cedar sauna will let you view its slightly red hue amongst the knots during a sauna session, and it boasts a pleasant cedar aroma. All lumber options are 1 ⅜" thick to insulate the sauna room. Door style: Outfit your sauna with one of the following three door options: fading glass, wood with a window, and all-wood. Heater: You can upgrade the Logan 1-person sauna from the standard 4.5kW heater to a 6kW. You can also add the luxury and ease of WiFi controls with the Harvia KIP45W or KIP60W with a Xenio Wi-Fi Control Panel. Shipping & Assembly The Logan 1-person indoor sauna will ship via an LTL truck and will arrive curbside on a single pallet. Some basic handyman skills are helpful when assembling the sauna. The only additional equipment needed is a cordless drill. Two people can generally do the assembly in 6 hours or less. It is recommended that you review the assembly manual in advance to familiarize yourself with the process. Care & Maintenance Traditional indoor and outdoor saunas require very little upkeep. Simply wipe down the interior after each use, and check for any dust or debris that you may have tracked in. Read more about long-term care and maintenance for traditional saunas here. Two Ways to Enjoy Your 1-Person Traditional Sauna Heater and stones are essential to a traditional sauna experience. With the room at least heated to 160ºF, the traditional sauna can be enjoyed in two ways. The first is called a dry sauna, which lacks any added moisture. The second is called a wet sauna, where you sprinkle water onto the heated stones to create a refreshing burst of steam and added humidity. Resources Logan Installation & Owner's Manual Videos
